title: Sweeten the Pot
description: Sweeten the Pot — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Use the information about the shipment drop to find the Smuggled Shipment. Bring the Shipment back to Agent Anise Rawgers in Balzack's Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: One Lump, or Two

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Use the information about the shipment drop to find the Smuggled Shipment. Bring the Shipment back to Agent Anise Rawgers in Balzack's Base Camp.

Offer:

OK, I had my crack team of specialists decipher this information. It looks like the next drop is going to be somewhere in The Cold Cave, located off of Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow. The TDA, no Townston, needs you to go down into The Cold Cave and recover that shipment for me. I mean for us, the TDA that is. I have no personal interest in the shipment contents. What?

Get running, Dungeon Runner. Go find that shipment before it is picked up by the Smuggling Agent in Balzack's Burrow. Then bring it back up to Balzack's Burrow Base Camp and turn it over to me, TDA Agent Anise Rawgers.

Turn-in:

Just as we suspected; it's Abadunkadunkaddonna who is suppliying the smuggling operation here. You may remeber (but probably don't) that Abadunkadunkaddonna is an Interpretive Dancer. She stands only to gain by keeping the monsters here dancing!

Objectives:

  • Smuggled ''Sweetener'' ×1

Level range: 55–100
